reviewer: Kimi actual visual review of the exact 156x210 source and enlarged source-page 19 crop, complete opaque RGB raw and native face crop, unchanged naiwa reference, and full white/cyan/source-alpha/RGB-no-alpha sheet/evidence. RGB art was rejected for missing strong brows before any alpha operation; no derivative or repair receipt was created.

remaining_reasons: The source has strong separate dark eyebrows, but the complete RGB raw and native face crop show no eyebrow above either green eye; the high yellow forehead/brow region is bare. Restore the source's two distinct strong dark brow shapes while retaining the swept black-brown hair, near-frontal half-smile and all other features. This is an RGB hair-features-v1 failure and must not be concealed by alpha repair.
entries.positive_observation: Full dark black-brown hair is brushed high and back from a high forehead with swept strands, close sides and short narrow sideburns. The face has no glasses, moustache or beard and one restrained closed-mouth half-smile. The near-frontal pose, forward gaze, crop and soft frontal modeling remain. The olive-khaki uniform keeps gold shoulder accents, elaborate gold-embroidered standing-collar patches, a narrow pale throat edge and one suspended gold order near the lower chest. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar, and the pale grey-beige/cream painted backplate fills the original rectangle. These correct properties do not offset the clearly absent eyebrows.
entries.visible_limitations: Individual hair strands, fine collar embroidery and the suspended order's interior cannot be resolved exactly at 156x210 and are not rejection grounds. The decisive brow absence is instead plainly visible in the native RGB crop, not an inference from faint or unreadable pixels.
